data.title: Tracing the Steps of a River Overflow
data.passage: First, heavy rains pour down onto the mountain slopes. Next, the small streams fill up with rushing water. After, the water level rises higher than the grassy banks. Finally, the muddy water spills across nearby streets and yards.

structureOptions.label: Time Order
structureOptions.description: Tells events in the order they happen

structureOptions.label: Cause and Effect
structureOptions.description: Shows why something happens and what happens

data.authorPurposeExplanation: The author used chronological structure to show the clear steps of how an overflowing river develops over time.
